input_restoration.direct_records: Every literal direct file token and the complete original hash-map dependencies are recorded above. Original absolute keys remain in their complete original plan files; normalizing to a repository path here does not change their original command.
input_restoration.raw_companions: Original raw companion metadata under each relevant accepted raw prefix is also registered. For shared or nested raw references restore the complete original topic tree at the pinned historical commit before numerical reconstruction; do not assume the small compressed index is the whole raw state.
input_restoration.complete_tree: The fixed historical topic tree is the source of complete original files already retired by earlier batches. No large input body was downloaded to populate this registry.
input_restoration.current_source_versions: All 65 small source bodies were actually read. The complete original plan hash entries for 47 distinct sources (51 original bindings) agree with their full-file SHA-256 values. Remaining writer/reader dependencies have complete current-fixed-snapshot records, without invented original hash evidence.
input_restoration.external_source_topic: The --source-topic argument is preserved literally. Descriptor preparation writes before the actual worker/nonlinear solve branch. A later complete scientific rerun still requires the separately recorded original external source-topic version; no same-named larger replacement is accepted as the missing 4752-byte client.
input_restoration.historical_consumer: Any historical consumer asking for a retired descriptor must recover that exact path/blob/size/SHA; another canonical or current-run descriptor is not an alias.

source_preservation: All original source files, configurations, plans, input records and publication/acceptance conclusions remain in the current tree or their exact pre-existing fixed recovery chains. Only six generated adapter JSON paths are proposed for deletion.
